full_prompt_en: This is a square, detailed solarpunk illustration of several futuristic figures set among branching urban structures and radiant golden disks. A large pale profile dominates the center-left, its light hair swept backward in long blue-gray strands. Oversized round amber lenses cover the eyes, reflecting concentric mechanical rings, while the chin lifts toward the upper right. Below and to the left, smaller figures cluster in warm ochre, rust, and cream clothing; one looks outward and another turns in profile. A red-haired figure near the lower right bends toward a small architectural platform and a patch of blue water. Behind them, dark narrow towers, thin supports, and tangled curved lines suggest a city interwoven with delicate infrastructure. At the top, sunlike circular machines radiate many fine orange spokes; one large disk glows near the upper right and a smaller one sits near the upper left. Pale sky and light cloudlike areas open between the denser machinery. Bright warm light from above catches hair, lenses, and the radial structures, while blue-gray shadows define the lower city forms and clothing. Thin drawn lines, scratched textures, and layered translucent color give the scene a print-and-paint finish rather than a smooth render. Circular motifs repeat at different scales, balancing the vertical spires and the diagonal sweep of the main profile. No writing is legible. The overall composition is optimistic and intricate, combining human faces, engineered light, and a crowded but breathable warm-cool palette.
full_prompt_zh: 这是一幅方形、细节丰富的太阳朋克插画，几名未来感人物置身分枝的城市结构和发光金色圆盘之间。一张大型浅色侧面面孔占据中央偏左，浅色头发以长长的蓝灰发丝向后掠去。夸张的琥珀色圆镜片遮住双眼，映着同心机械环，抬起的下巴朝向右上。下方与左边，较小的人物穿暖赭、锈色和奶油色衣服聚在一起；一人向外看，另一人侧身。右下附近，一名红发人物俯向小型建筑平台和一块蓝色水域。他们身后，深色狭窄塔形、细支架与纠缠弯线暗示一座与精细基础结构交织的城市。顶部，太阳般的圆形机器放射许多细橙色辐条；一轮大圆盘在右上附近发亮，一轮较小的在左上。浅色天空与云状亮区在更密的机械之间打开。明亮暖光从上方照到头发、镜片和放射结构，蓝灰阴影则界定下方城市形体与衣物。细绘线、刮擦肌理和层叠透明色赋予场景印刷与绘画结合的完成面，而非平滑渲染。圆形母题以不同尺度重复，平衡竖向尖塔和主面孔的斜向扫动。没有可读文字。整体构图乐观而精巧，将人的面孔、工程化光源和拥挤却仍能呼吸的冷暖配色结合。
style_prompt_en: The illustration layers precise radial linework, translucent colored planes, and densely scratched structural texture. Amber, ochre, rust, pale cream, and blue-gray form a warm-cool balance, with glowing circular areas punctuating cooler linear masses. Long diagonal sweeps cross narrow vertical rhythms, while repeated rings at several scales give the complexity a visual order. Bright upper light catches exposed edges and lets pale gaps remain open inside crowded detail. Fine lines and printlike grain keep the surface tactile; smooth focal planes offer rest beside intricate peripheral marks. Depth comes from overlap and changes in line density more than conventional perspective. The overall effect is inventive, luminous, and optimistic, with complex construction held together by radiating light.
style_prompt_zh: 这种插画叠加精确的放射线、透明色平面与浓密刮擦的结构肌理。琥珀、赭、锈色、浅奶油和蓝灰形成冷暖平衡，发光圆形区域点亮较冷的线性体量。绵长斜向扫线横过狭窄竖向节奏，不同尺度的重复圆环为复杂性提供视觉秩序。上方亮光照到外露边缘，使浅色间隙在拥挤细节中仍保持敞开。细线与印刷般颗粒令表面有触感；平滑焦点平面在繁复外围痕迹旁提供休息处。纵深主要来自重叠和线条密度变化，而非传统透视。整体效果有创造力、明亮且乐观，复杂构造由放射光线联系起来。
theme_en: A group of futuristic figures beneath golden solar disks and branching city structures
theme_zh: 一群未来感人物位于金色太阳圆盘与分枝城市结构之下
name: Solarpunk
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
